run_bm_diff_cli: run bm_diff.py with --old and --new flags to compare two benchmark runs and print significant differences
run_diff_function: run the diff function with benchmark names, loops, regex filter, and track metrics to compute performance changes
create_Benchmark_class: create a Benchmark instance to collect old and new samples then call process to find significant metric changes
run_bm_diff_with_regex: run bm_diff.py with --regex flag to filter which benchmarks are compared between old and new runs
run_bm_diff_no_counters: run bm_diff.py with --no-counters flag to compare only optimization metrics without counter data
